items.title: Bob Havens interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Monk Huffman in Quincy, was a piano player. So I started playing with his orchestra.

ctx.x: Monk Huffman in Quincy, was a piano player. So I started playing with his orchestra. Then another band kind of got the word and well I also started playing with a group called the Red Ramblers Orchestra. And we had a violin and guitar and drums, and bass and piano. I think that was it.
So this music that you were playing at this time, was it somewhat improvised?
